content:
maya-peopleops: Quick plan proposal 1: 'Thank-you Postcard' desk-drop + 10 micro spot-awards (digital $75) the week before EOY all-hands. Small, distributed, low-cost. Thoughts?
liam-culture: Love the tactile idea. Postcards feel more personal than swag. 
noor-hr: Policy check: are spot-awards taxable? We usually treat <$100 as a de minimis fringe but need to confirm with finance.
tess-eng: I can help design a postcard template if you want a code snippet/QR to the nomination form.
omar-ops: Logistics 1: need address opt-in for remote folks. Can we do a mix of desk-drop (SF) + mailers?
kudos-bot: New nomination submitted by tess-eng 1 "Ben helped unblock our staging infra" :sparkles:
maya-peopleops: Good call @omar. Let's collect addresses via form opt-in. If no address, default to digital card.
ben-recruiting: I can coordinate shipping labels if you give me the spreadsheet. Heads up: international postage is pricier; maybe limit physical kits to US.
noor-hr: Also note managers can nominate, but we should surface conflicts to the panel. Will prepare a short blurb on recusal rules.
liam-culture: Volunteers: Liam (print + assembly), Maya (nom form + comms), Tess (design), Samira (virtual acknowledgements).
samira-support: Happy to do virtual wraps and announce winners in #general.
maya-peopleops: Budget sketch: postcards + printing $120, postage $80 (US small batch), 10 digital cards $75 = $870 total? Wait math check.
omar-ops: Math check: 10*$75 = $750 for digital? I think you meant 10*$75 = $750, plus printing and postage = $950. If we do mixed (5 physical + 5 digital) it's ~5*75 + printing/postage = $525.
noor-hr: Finance will need vendor invoice and staff distribution list for record keeping. I'll prep the short policy note for the nomination form.
liam-culture: Proposed timeline: Nom open Mon 11/20 - Fri 11/24, assembly weekend 11/25, desk-drops/mail 11/27-11/29, announce at 12/1 all-hands. Good?
tess-eng: that's tight but doable. I need the final wording by Wed 11/22 for print.
ben-recruiting: I'll add a shipping column to the volunteer sheet and flag international folks.
maya-peopleops: Action items (please reply with done): 1) create nom form + opt-in (Maya) 2) postcard mockups (Tess) 3) vendor/print quote (Liam) 4) shipping list + labels (Ben/Omar) 5) policy blurb & tax check (Noor).
kudos-bot: Reminder set by kudos-bot 1 Nomination form closes in 7 days.
maya-peopleops: If anyone else wants to help assembly weekend, shout here and I'll slot you. Also planning a tiny thank-you gift for volunteers (coffee cards).
liam-culture: I'll bring scissors/tape and extra envelopes.
maya-peopleops: Sweet. Will post the form link when ready and ping finance for the tax confirmation. "Thanks team!"
